subject: Three-way slot harmonization for architect deep dive
messages:
From: Alex Morton <alex.morton@cloudwize.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@fintech.co.uk>, Li Wei <li.wei@apacinfra.sg>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2026 15:22:00 -0400
Subject: Three-way slot harmonization for architect deep dive

Hi Sean / Marissa / Hiro —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. The CloudWize network architecture team (Samantha and Li) would like a 90-minute technical deep dive with one of your solutions engineers + an architect from Redwood to walk through:

- current ingestion/throughput expectations for our 1M monthly requests workload
- expected latency under steady-state and burst scenarios
- deployment options (hosted vs. dedicated vs. private) and VPN/KMS constraints

We are distributed across NA/EU/APAC, so finding overlap is annoying — US DST and EU DST windows are slightly different right now. To speed things up, here are three candidate windows (all durations 90 minutes) in local times with UTC conversions:

A) Tue May 25 — 08:30–10:00 PDT / 11:30–13:00 EDT / 16:30–18:00 BST / 23:30–01:00 SGT (UTC+8)
B) Wed May 26 — 16:00–17:30 BST / 11:00–12:30 EDT / 08:00–09:30 PDT / 23:00–00:30 SGT
C) Thu May 27 — 02:00–03:30 SGT / 17:00–18:30 BST / 12:00–13:30 EDT / 09:00–10:30 PDT

If any of these work, pick a preference (1/2/3). If not, happy to accept what you can make available — we're flexible the week of May 24–28.

I attached a quick mutual action plan and a tiny CSV with our desired attendees so you can eyeball overlap (mutual-action-plan_CW_v1.pdf, attendees_overlap.csv).

Best,
Alex Morton
Director of Infrastructure, CloudWize
alex.morton@cloudwize.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morton <alex.morton@cloudwize.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2026 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Three-way slot harmonization for architect deep dive

Alex —

Thanks for laying out the options and for the MAP. Good call flagging DST — we see that bite teams often. Quick notes:

- We can staff a solutions engineer + senior architect for any 90-minute slot.
- Slot A looks tight for APAC (it pushes late local time) but is otherwise okay.
- Slot B is the best overlap for EU/US daytime; Slot C is basically APAC-friendly but will be early for NA.

Converted to UTC to make this simple: A) 15:30–17:00 UTC, B) 15:00–16:30 UTC, C) 00:00–01:30 UTC.

Two practical asks from our side so the session is productive:
1) Please add a short list (bullet points) of the top 3 app flows you want us to demo (ingest, real-time scoring, long-form batch).
2) Provide any network diagrams or firewall rules we should be aware of ahead of time (small PDF or even a SharePoint/GDrive link).

I've attached an overlap grid I generated (overlap_grid_may2026.csv) that shows preferred ranges by office location and daylight-saving adjustments. If you want, I can post a Doodle/Calendly poll (we use a lightweight polling link to avoid calendar spam).

If CloudWize prefers a solid pick, we can lock Slot B (Wed May 26 15:00–16:30 UTC) — I can send a calendar invite that includes a Zoom link and a Miro board for the architecture walk-through.

Sean Gallagher
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: overlap_grid_may2026.csv, redwood-demo-checklist.md

Thanks, Sean — that UTC conversion was helpful. Our engineering manager says Slot B (Wed May 26 15:00–16:30 UTC) is her preferred option (best overlap for the EU folks, and late-morning in the US).

Top 3 flows we'd like covered:
- API ingestion + backpressure handling
- Real-time scoring latency for 2k qps bursts
- Key rotation / KMS integration and audit logging behavior

If you can lock Slot B, we'll confirm internal attendees and send any diagrams this afternoon. Prefer a Zoom link + a Miro board for the session.

Samantha Cho
Senior Network Architect, CloudWize
